products.name: ARQ Astra
products.oneLine: Connects to TallyPrime and shows who owes you, what stock is stuck and which MSME payments are due. Ask questions in your own language.
products.audience: Owners and accounts teams who run TallyPrime.
products.problem: Your Tally holds the answers, but getting them out takes a CA, a spreadsheet or a free evening. Money sits with customers, stock sits on shelves, and payments to small suppliers run past the 45-day limit.

featuresLive.title: Receivables ageing
featuresLive.text: See who owes you, how much and for how long, from Tally or an Excel upload.

featuresLive.title: Reminder drafts
featuresLive.text: Get a ready message for each overdue party. You copy it into WhatsApp and send it yourself. ARQ never sends on its own.

featuresLive.title: MSME 45-day alert
featuresLive.text: Know which payments to micro and small suppliers are close to, or past, the 45-day limit.

featuresLive.title: Dead stock
featuresLive.text: See stock items that have not moved, so you can act before more money gets stuck.

featuresLive.title: Owner daily brief
featuresLive.text: A short summary of what needs attention today.

featuresNext.title: Statutory calendar
featuresNext.text: MSME payments, ROC filings, pollution board returns and labour code deadlines in one list.

featuresNext.title: Daily brief on WhatsApp
featuresNext.text: The owner brief delivered where you already read your messages.

featuresNext.title: Marg ERP as a second data source

steps.title: Install the connector
steps.text: Put the small ARQ app on the Windows PC where Tally runs. It reads from Tally and does not write to it.

steps.title: See your numbers
steps.text: Your data appears on your dashboard, with a daily brief on what needs attention.

steps.title: Ask in your language
steps.text: Ask in English, Hindi, Marathi or Gujarati, for example which customers have not paid in 45 days.

faq.q: Does ARQ change my Tally data?
faq.a: No. The connector only reads from Tally.

faq.q: Does it message my customers by itself?
faq.a: No. Reminders are drafts. You copy them and send them yourself.

faq.q: What do I need to install?
faq.a: A small Windows app on the PC where Tally runs.
Your Tally data is synced to ARQ's cloud so the dashboard can show it. Ask us for the current hosting details and we will share them in writing.
Pricing is on enquiry. There is a free 14-day trial.

seo.title: ARQ Astra: AI for your Tally data | ARQ ONE AI Labs
seo.description: Receivables ageing, MSME 45-day alerts, dead stock and a daily brief from your TallyPrime data. English, Hindi, Marathi and Gujarati. 14-day free trial.

products.audience: Plant owners, supervisors and maintenance teams.
products.problem: Machine details live in a supervisor's head or a register. Breakdowns are remembered, not recorded, and maintenance is missed until something stops.

featuresLive.title: Easy machine onboarding
featuresLive.text: Add machines from an Excel sheet, a photo of the nameplate, or by speaking.

featuresLive.title: Voice breakdown and downtime log

featuresLive.title: Maintenance due list
featuresLive.text: See which machines are due for service and which are overdue.

featuresLive.title: Daily brief
featuresLive.text: A short summary of breakdowns and maintenance due.

featuresNext.title: More ways to capture machine data
featuresNext.text: We are working on more capture options. Tell us what your plant needs.

steps.title: Add your machines
steps.text: Upload an Excel sheet, photograph the nameplate, or say the details out loud.

steps.title: Log breakdowns by voice
steps.text: Speak in your language. The entry, the machine and the time are recorded for you.

steps.title: Act on the due list
steps.text: Check the maintenance due list and the daily brief each morning.

faq.q: Do I need sensors on my machines?
faq.a: No. Machines are logged by people, by voice or from a sheet.
Indian languages including Hindi, Marathi and Gujarati, and English.
It is built for anyone in a plant with machines to look after: owners, supervisors and maintenance staff.
Pricing is on enquiry. There is a free 14-day trial.

products.name: ARQ Dravya
products.tagline: Keep your supplier GST credit safe.
products.oneLine: Matches your purchases against GSTR-2B so you see which supplier credits are at risk before you claim them. In development.
products.audience: Owners, accounts teams and CAs who handle GST for manufacturers.
products.problem: Your input tax credit depends on your suppliers filing correctly. If a supplier does not file, your credit can be at risk, and finding out late is expensive.

featuresNext.title: GSTR-2B matching
featuresNext.text: Match your purchase records from Tally against what suppliers have filed.

featuresNext.title: Supplier risk list
featuresNext.text: See which suppliers have not filed, or filed differently, before you claim the credit.

featuresNext.title: A clean report for your CA
featuresNext.text: One clear list of mismatches, so your CA does not start from zero.

products.whyNotYet: It reads the same Tally data as ARQ Astra, so it is built on the same foundation.
products.notThis: Dravya is not a billing app and does not replace your CA. It reads the data you already keep.
products.disclaimer: ARQ is software, not a tax adviser. Confirm filings with your CA.

faq.a: No. It is in development. You can join the early list.
No. The aim is to show you the risk before you file. Filing stays with you and your CA.
